component.name: arraw
component.summary: Lightweight RAW photo editor with a real-time GPU preview

description.p: arraw is a lightweight, cross-platform RAW photo editor with a Lightroom-style development workflow: open a folder, edit non-destructively with a real-time GPU preview, and export. It is an editor for developing and culling photos, not a catalogue or digital-asset manager.

ul.li: Non-destructive editing with Lightroom-compatible XMP sidecars
Real-time GPU preview of every adjustment
Tone curves, local adjustments, crop and straighten
Culling with ratings and colour labels
